title: Topological Data Analysis of Cosmic Web Filaments via Persistent Homology
abstract: Persistent homology applied to cosmological density fields yields a robust, multi-scale topological descriptor of cosmic web filaments. Birth-death persistence pairs in H1 encode filament longevity and connectivity, providing a natural bridge to the Cosmological Assembly Index (A_c). Persistence images offer ML-ready representations validated against Illustris/EAGLE simulations and SDSS catalogs.

pipeline: Density estimation: Gaussian kernel smoothing of N-body particle distributions or galaxy redshift surveys
Filtration construction: Sublevel sets of density field via Vietoris-Rips or alpha-complexes
Persistent homology computation: Track H0 and H1 across scales
Persistence diagram extraction: Each (b,d) pair quantifies a topological feature's lifespan
Persistence image generation: Kernel density estimate for noise-robust ML input
Cross-validation: Compare against IllustrisTNG halo merger trees and geometric filament finders

key_metrics.total_persistence: Sum over all H1 features per halo/volume

results.simulation_validation: Filament persistence correlates with halo assembly history in IllustrisTNG; high-persistence filaments trace major merger channels
results.observational_agreement: SDSS-based persistence images recover known supercluster topology
results.novel_insight: Filament persistence serves as a proxy for A_c in large-scale structure

cloud9_integration.ac_relevance: Topological persistence provides a geometric-complexity measure complementary to A_c. Hypothesis: A_c(halo) ∝ Σ_persistence(H1 in 2R_vir neighborhood).
cloud9_integration.snn_implementation: Persistence images fed into Lava-based SNN as spike-encoded 2D feature maps.

validation_against_tng.halos: 2000+ quiescent halos with stellar mass > 10^10 M_sun
validation_against_tng.test: Bootstrap correlation between total H1 persistence within 2R_vir and A_c score

cross_cluster_links.relation: Barontini entropic-time experiment provides discrete-order substrate for filtration construction
Sgr A* wind cavity topology can be characterized by persistent H1 in MHD simulations
Frontal aslant tract white-matter connectivity maps share persistent-homology structure with cosmic web

risks_and_limitations: Computational cost of persistent homology scales as O(n^3) for naive implementations
Density estimation kernel choice introduces bias in persistence diagrams
Observational redshift-space distortions can artificially inflate/depress persistence
Causal direction unclear: do high-persistence filaments cause high A_c, or vice versa?
next_experiments: Run Ripser on TNG100-1 density grid (512^3) for 50 quiescent halos; correlate total persistence with A_c
Compare DisPerSE geometric filaments vs persistent-homology filaments for same volume
Train SNN on persistence images of quiescent vs star-forming halos
Apply to DESI DR1 data when available
references: Sousbie, T. et al. — DisPerSE: robust structure identification (2011)
Xu et al. — Probing the Cosmic Web with Persistent Homology (2019)
Pranav et al. — Topology of the Cosmic Web (2017)
Otter et al. — A roadmap for the computation of persistent homology (2017)

audit_trail.key_risk: Computational scaling limits for full-box TNG runs
audit_trail.rationale: Persistent homology is mature math with stability theorems. Application to cosmology has peer-reviewed precedent. The A_c bridge is speculative but testable.
